{{Quote|I'm a Jedi. I'm one with the Force, and the Force will guide me.|Ganodi|<ref name="TCW:TG" />}}
'''Ganodi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Gathering on Ilum===
[[File:Ganodi-Crystal_Caves.png|thumb|left|250px|Ganodi searching for her lightsaber crystal within the Crystal Caves.]]
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], Ganodi was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Order's members were forced to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. As the war was waged around them, Ganodi was deemed to be one of the top members of her [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|clan]] and suitable to travel to the sacred Jedi world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to participate in the ancient ritual known as [[Gathering/Legends|The Gathering]]. Escorted to Ilum by [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Ganodi and several other Initiates met with [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in the [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|Jedi temple]] at the mouth of the [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Crystal Caves]].<ref name="TCW:TG" />

Entering into the caves in search of a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] for use in her personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Ganodi was accompanied by fellow Initiate [[Gungi/Legends|Gungi]] as they searched the labyrinthine caves. Coming across a massive subterranean lake, Gungi was confident that his crystal lay on a frozen island in the midst of the lake. Parting ways so the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] could pursue his own journey, Ganodi delved deeper into the caves, finding her mission to be hopeless as she couldn't find any crystals. Cursing her mentors for sending her into the caves to freeze to death, Ganodi fell into a cave filled with crystals, and was struck by the fear she would not be able to find her own unique crystal most attuned to her. Despite her fear, Ganodi found hope in the Force and was guided to the correct crystal, revealing the others to simply be illusions created by the caves manipulation of her fears. Making her way out of the caves and back to the Temple when the crystal was secured in her pocket, Master Yoda commended her on finding hope in the Force.<ref name="TCW:TG" />

===Attack on the ''Crucible''===
{{Quote|But he's a droid. You expect us to learn from a droid?|Ganodi talking about Huyang|<ref name="ATOS">{{TCW|A Test of Strength}}</ref>}}
Returning to the [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], Ganodi and the rest of the younglings were eager to undertake the next part of their training&mdash;the actual construction of their lightsabers. On board, they met [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], an ancient [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who taught lightsaber construction aboard the vessel. Ganodi was surprised that a droid would be able to train them in a Jedi art form, but Huyang assured the young Rodian that he was more than proficient in the matter. Huyang showed the younglings countless models of lightsabers, then asked them to visualize their own particular models. Once they were able to see their saber in their minds, only then would they be able to build the weapon. The meditation and construction, however, were interrupted by a sudden attack by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[Ohnaka Gang|his pirate gang]].<ref name="ATOS" />

Fortunately, Tano devised a plan to remove the ship from the pirates. Ganodi and Zatt were able to follow her plan and reach the cockpit where they were ordered to work with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to get the power restored. In the process of disengaging from the pirate ship, the [[Acushnet/Legends|''Acushnet'']], Tano was caught in the vacuum's pull. Though she was able to force every pirate from the ''Crucible'', she ended up aboard the ''Acushnet'' instead, where she was quickly captured.

===Rescuing Ahsoka===
After Ahsoka was kidnapped by Hondo and his gang, Ganodi and the younglings continued their training onboard the ''Crucible'' where they were able to construct their lightsabers successfully, except Katooni. After receiving distress signal from [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Ganodi followed Petro's way in rescuing Ahsoka when the ship's coolant was leaking. While the other younglings went on to rescue Ahsoka, Ganodi was indeed the only Youngling of the group to stay since she had attended [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] training.<ref name="Bound">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref>

[[File:StandingUpToGrievous-ANB.png|thumb|right|250px|Ganodi and her friends stand up to General Grievous]]

===Battle of Florrum===
After the Younglings were successful in rescuing Ahsoka during an entertainment of [[Preigo/Legends|Preigo's]] [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Traveling World of Wonder]], Ganodi received contact from Petro to prepare the ship and leave Florrum. Eventually they could not escape when Ahsoka and the Younglings were been chased by [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]] and a group of pirates that were able to pick up their trail. The pirates were successful in capturing them after the ''Crucible'' had crashed. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Droid Army|droid army]] invaded the planet, Ahsoka and the younglings convinced them to free them and work together in rescuing Hondo Ohnaka.<ref name="ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

Eventually, they were able to find Hondo's cell and Hondo convinced the younglings to show him their lightsabers and see if they were ready for battle against the Separatists, but Katooni was the only one who didn't finish hers. After freeing the rest of prisoners, Ganodi and the younglings went into battle against the droid army and were able to escape the planet from [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. The Younglings were safe with Obi-Wan when Hondo deposited them back to friendly space.

==Personality and traits==
Ganodi was somewhat unconfident like her classmate [[Katooni/Legends|Katooni]], but was very lively, smart, and had a bit of an attitude sometimes. She was the only known member of her clan to be able to fly a starship.

==Powers and abilities==
Ganodi was a young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] and one of the top in her class. She is able to use telekinesis being able to build her own lightsaber. She is capable with a lightsaber being able to strike down several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], she is also the only one among her group that has pilot skills. Ganodi was also able to make repairs to [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] after he was damaged.
